title: Amorite father, Hittite mother — one and many
english: [[Your origin is from Canaan; your father an Amorite, your mother a Hittite >> Bible:Ezekiel 16:3]]. Later the address multiplies — [[your mother… your father >> Bible:Ezekiel 16:45]] — because spreading sin makes many sinners in one.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).

title: Compare carefully; difference not chance
english: A careful reader compares earlier and later oracles; the shift from singular to plural is no accident. Glory to Christ. Amen.
